items.q: How does the photo scan work?
items.a: Take a photo of your meal. CalorAI's AI recognises the food and estimates the portion, then calculates calories, protein, carbs and fat.
The AI gives an estimate, like a nutrition label does. You can always adjust a meal before you save it.
CalorAI is available in 18 languages, including English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Turkish, Farsi and Kurdish.

items.q: Can I use CalorAI with a health condition?
items.a: CalorAI can warn you about ingredients that may not suit you, but it is not medical advice. Always follow your doctor's guidance.
Yes. The whole app is available in Arabic with a right-to-left layout, and the AI recognises dishes from many cuisines, including Middle Eastern and Gulf meals.

items.q: Do I have to take a photo?
items.a: No. You can also type what you ate or say it out loud, for example "grilled chicken with rice, 200 grams", and CalorAI calculates the nutrition.
Yes. Choose from over 100 exercises, set the duration and intensity, and the calories you burn are added to your daily target.

items.q: Does CalorAI work on iPhone and Android?
items.a: Yes. CalorAI is available on Google Play for Android and on the App Store for iPhone and iPad.
CalorAI is made by Intellivation AB, a small independent company in Sweden.

howPage.title: How it works
howPage.heading: How CalorAI works
howPage.sub: Set up in a minute, then log every meal with one photo.

steps.title: Create your profile
steps.text: Tell CalorAI your age, height, weight and goal. It calculates your daily calories and macros for you.

steps.title: Snap your meal
steps.text: Open the camera and take a photo of your plate. No barcodes, no typing.

steps.title: Check and save
steps.text: CalorAI shows what it found and the calories, protein, carbs and fat. Adjust if you like, then save it to your diary.

steps.title: Follow your day
steps.text: Your rings update after every meal. Log workouts and the burned calories are added to your target.

steps.title: Get help when you need it
steps.text: Ask your AI coach what to eat, get a meal plan for the week and see your progress in the calendar.

tips: Take the photo from above, with the whole plate in view.
Good light helps the AI see your food.
Log meals as you eat. It takes seconds and you won't forget.
Check the portion before saving if your plate is unusual.

aboutPage.title: About us
aboutPage.heading: Healthy eating should be easy
aboutPage.sub: We build CalorAI so anyone can understand what they eat, without spreadsheets or guesswork.
aboutPage.mission: Counting calories used to mean weighing food and typing every ingredient. Many people gave up before they saw results. We believe a photo should be enough. CalorAI uses AI to turn a picture of your meal into clear numbers and simple advice, so you can make better choices and keep going.

values.title: Simple first
values.text: Every feature should save you time. If it needs a manual, we redesign it.

values.title: For everyone
values.text: CalorAI speaks 18 languages, including right-to-left languages like Arabic, Farsi and Kurdish.

values.title: Honest numbers
values.text: We show estimates clearly and let you adjust them. We never promise miracles.

values.title: Your data, your choice
values.text: You can delete your account and all your data from inside the app at any time.

aboutPage.company: CalorAI is made by Intellivation AB in Sweden, a small independent team of developers and designers who care about health and good software. We read every message and use your feedback to decide what to build next.

deletePage.title: Delete account
deletePage.heading: Delete your CalorAI account
deletePage.sub: You can permanently delete your account and all your data at any time.
steps: Tap the More tab at the bottom of the screen.
Scroll down and tap Delete account.
Confirm twice. Your account is deleted right away.
deletePage.what: Your profile, food diary, photos, meal plans, workouts, weight history, coach conversations, badges and community posts are permanently removed from our servers. This cannot be undone.
deletePage.subs: Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription bought through Google Play or the App Store. Cancel it in your store account settings to stop future payments.
deletePage.noApp: Email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete your account and data within 30 days.
